meta.description: Standardizes molecular structures with the ChEMBL structure pipeline and RDKit rdMolStandardize for QSAR preparation, deduplication, registry normalization, salt handling, tautomer policy, stereochemistry, and isotope treatment.
meta.evidence: run/reaudit_fixed_findings.py/.out plus exact-current-runtime input3_reaudit.out and input4_reaudit.out

skill_veto.detail: The committed bundled example byte-compiles, its demo executes, and the exact-commit focused re-audit exits 0.

scientific_integrity.detail: The skill distinguishes reproducible canonical representation from a physical tautomer prediction and now preserves measurement disagreement for review.

practice_boundaries.detail: The skill prepares molecular records and does not make patient-specific clinical claims.

methodological_ground.detail: The ChEMBL multi-fragment rule is checked after parent selection; optional largest-fragment fallback is explicit.

code_usability.detail: The bundled implementation validates requested columns, returns status counts, supports row-level isotope retention, and completed the 3,966-row regression fixture.

functional_suitability.note: All promised ChEMBL, RDKit, QSAR, tautomer, charge, salt, and identity workflows are covered, including the formerly undocumented multi-fragment ChEMBL result.

reliability.note: Every input now receives an outcome counter; ambiguous multi-fragment parents are flagged by default and all error paths are visible to callers.

performance_context.note: The guidance intentionally contains detailed pipeline material and some explanatory duplication; measured 3,966-row ChEMBL preparation remains practical.

agent_usability.note: The reference implementation, status-return contract, fallback policy, column errors, isotope option, and replicate-QC policy are explicit.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger phrases and concise guidance route users to the appropriate standardization policy.

security.note: No credentials, network calls, shell-outs, or dynamic code execution; caller-supplied data columns are validated with actionable errors.

maintainability.note: The three-file skill layout is coherent and the audit adds executable regression evidence; the example remains a compact reference script rather than a packaged test suite.

agent_specific.note: Precise activation, explicit scientific caveats, related-skill routes, and an authorized fallback make the skill robust; co-crystal selection still properly requires domain judgment.

key_strengths: The ChEMBL and RDKit standardization routes are explicitly differentiated and scientifically bounded.
The committed example now makes input loss, ambiguous parent selection, isotope policy, and replicate disagreement observable.
The exact-commit hERG regression fixture preserves the original 3,208-identity result while adding 47 actionable replicate-disagreement flags.
Every changed behavior is covered by an executable re-audit that exits successfully in the original audit environment.
